remarks: Welcome to this beautifully renovated 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo in the heart of downtown Stamford. This turnkey, ranch-level home offers a seamless open-concept layout, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The updated kitchen features quartz countertops, tiled backsplash, and newer stainless steel appliances (2023), flowing effortlessly into the sun-filled living and dining areas. Enjoy abundant natural light and picturesque views of downtown Stamford and Scalzi Park, with direct access to a private balcony, perfect for relaxing or taking in stunning sunset views. The spacious primary suite includes a full en-suite bath, while the second bedroom offers generous space and ample closet storage. A second full bathroom adds convenience for guests or everyday use. Hardwood flooring runs throughout, enhancing the home's clean and modern feel. Additional highlights include central air, a full-size in-unit washer and dryer, and a reserved covered garage parking space. Residents enjoy access to a fitness center and sauna. Just minutes to Stamford Train Station, Mill River Park, I-95, and downtown dining, shopping, and entertainment. A true move-in ready opportunity in one of Stamford's most desirable locations.
